name: schema_decoding_v1
purpose: Resolve the new schema failure separately from content reasoning. Fixed 2x2 prompt/decoder comparison using archived unconstrained controls; 16 new schema-constrained calls only.
selection: ALL 8 quality-eligible successes, including every single-step case; not selected by prior distillation validity. Explicit development/replay set, not held out.
control: Archived original image prompt 5/8 valid, archived action-grounded image prompt 0/8. No unconstrained request regenerated.
input_boundary: Both arms use original saved initial/terminal images and actual policy actions/success. Only the second uses the already-frozen action-grounded prompt. Schema is generic identical across all cases, contains no correct direction/distance/action sequence. No board, positions, computed answer or verifier feedback supplied.
verification: Unchanged semantic validator and admission gates. Generic schema constrains output structure/types and action/direction vocabulary only. Raw outputs retained, no repairs.
decision: Prefer original-prompt schema arm if all 8 cases including all 3 multi-step validate; otherwise action-grounded schema arm must meet the identical criterion. No qualified arm means no PPO and no further prompt search on these eight cases in this campaign; record semantic limitations and formulate a distinct bounded mainline diagnosis.
stop: Exactly 16 new greedy requests, no optimizer/checkpoint/library admission. New hypothesis is decoder structure control; not an extension of the completed 16-call grounding run. Repairs share first receipt deadline; do not repeat completed requests.
